verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a programmatic JMAP API with a session endpoint at api.fastmail.com, API-token and Bearer auth, and batched HTTP method calls. That allows non-interactive, scripted use without the web UI. A community user also reports running automated transactional sending via an SMTP-only app password. However, nothing documents CI usage or ships a first-party CLI or headless runner, so automation means writing your own JMAP client. Missing for 10: official CLI/headless tool, CI-specific docs or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven automation, machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
Standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. No custom auth protocol to implement.
POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
Uses Fastmail SMTP for transactional emails with an app password that can only access SMTP.
